Sasha: bringing up arcturus14b int4 on canary pool — observing intermittent OOMs and a sharp drop in tokens/sec on some hosts. attaching a tiny log snippet below and the config we used. anyone seen this pattern with heavy codegen prompts?

Sasha: ```
[2026-03-21T14:02:11Z] serve: request id=rx1 host=gpu-node-12 mem=62GB/80GB kv_cache=7.4GB prefetched=2.1GB tokens/sec=180
[2026-03-21T14:02:12Z] oom_error: alloc failed at new_tokens=512 slot=0
[2026-03-21T14:02:12Z] fallback: routed to fp16-variant
```

Omar: thanks — two quick checks: what are batch_size and max_new_tokens defaults on this canary? also is prefetch on? those OOMs + low throughput smell like aggressive prefetch + large max_new_tokens causing KV cache spike and fragmentation.

Linh: config we used: `batch_size=8`, `max_new_tokens_default=256`, `prefetch_enabled=true`, `prefetch_ahead_tokens=512`, `eviction_policy=lazy`. Perf numbers from the run (5m sample): median tokens/sec 210 but p95 drops to 60 when fragmentation hits. heap compaction happens ~every 30s but ineffective. heap map shows many small allocations.

Ashley: did you run the quality/eval suite after quantizing? any regressions in rouge/perplexity or hallucination signals? we need to weigh cost vs quality before fallback.

Sasha: ran our 200-case eval set — perplexity +1.8% and code-gen exact-match down 2.5% on edge cases. not catastrophic but the OOMs produce hard failures for customers so availability > small perf win.

Linh: Hypothesis: prefetch window + large max_new_tokens creates very skewed sequence length distribution; continuous batching tries to pack but ends up holding many KV slices. With int4 we see fragmentation because allocator uses many small slots. Mitigations I propose:
- lower `max_new_tokens_default` from 256 -> 128 for canary
- reduce `prefetch_ahead_tokens` 512 -> 128
- set `batch_size` soft cap 6 (auto-shrink under memory pressure)
- enable `kv_compaction=true` with interval 15s

Linh: quick deploy command to try on canary group: `redwoodctl rollout canary arcturus14b --set max_new_tokens_default=128 --set prefetch_ahead_tokens=128 --set batch_size=6 --set kv_compaction=true`

Omar: also add a temporary routing rule: if request tokens (prompt+est_new) > 512 route to fp16-variant. That keeps int4 for normal loads and fails over for tail cases. I'll draft a canary policy.

deploy-bot: Canary policy created (canary_id=c-201). Traffic split: 5% to canary, 95% to stable. Applied config overrides per Linh's command. Monitoring hooks added for OOMs and tokens/sec.

Ashley: please run the eval suite again on the canary after 30m of steady traffic, and post the results here. if quality regresses beyond our threshold (EM drop >4% or perplexity >3%), we'll pause and investigate quant calibration.

Sasha: agreed — will kick off evals 15m after rollout, share results and CI logs. plan B if OOMs persist: rollback to fp16-variant and open a ticket to iterate allocator (short-term knob: increase compaction aggressiveness + tune slot-reserve).

Omar: I'll also add a temporary SLO for token-latency at canary so alerting fires before user impact. thanks team :thumbsup:

Sasha: thanks — updating the ticket with config diffs and links to perf dashboards. ping me if you want join the canary watch at 14:30.
